module: Node "Perlin Noise" (repeat_instant). Produces a coherent pseudo-random number (octave Perlin noise) as a function of an input value, for example time. Inputs: flow, value (seed/abscissa), octaves (6), amplitude (128), frequency (4), normalize (false), randomStartSeed (true, randomly offsets the abscissa at each start). Outputs: flow, value. "Smooth" and "Natural" preset buttons in the inspector; a debug graph is drawn in the node (data.debug). Implementation adapted from a gist by kymckay.
notes: The OctavePerlin loop goes from 0 to octaves inclusive: there are octaves+1 passes.
In _executionStarted, amplitude.value is read for the graph scale; without a value the line would fail.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes the graph buffer, the seed, data.debug=true and data.graphDataCount=1000.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the "Smooth preset" and "Natural preset" buttons that set frequency/amplitude/octaves.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the curve of the latest values if data.debug.

_executionStarted.desc: Clears the graph, sets the scale, fills the permutation table (doubled) and draws the random seed if randomStartSeed.

work.desc: If flow is active, computes OctavePerlin(randomStartSeed + value, 0, 0, ...), feeds the graph and writes value and flow.

OctavePerlin.desc: Sums the noise over several octaves (frequency ×2 and amplitude ÷2 at each octave); divides by the sum of the amplitudes if normalize.

noise.desc: Basic 3D Perlin noise (interpolation of the 8 corners of the unit cube).

grad.desc: Pseudo-random gradient chosen according to the 4 low bits of the hash.

lerp.desc: Linear interpolation a + t(b-a) (called without self).
